title: DeviceInfo
description: What an unclaimed device tells the app before pairing: BLE 'info' characteristic (read) or GET http://192.168.4.1/info in Wi-Fi setup mode. UTF-8 JSON, at most 512 bytes.

pubkey.description: Device provisioning public key: uncompressed P-256 point (65 bytes, 0x04 || X || Y). The app checks it against the key the cloud returns for this did.

claimed.description: true when the device still holds an owner binding (a factory reset clears it).
